mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 67 degrees and clear at Verona City Hall with a beautiful Full Moon overhead. If you are an early riser, look for the International Space Station at 4:11 AM as it moves from the West Northwest near Cross Plains toward the Northeast near Madison, staying low on the horizon.

The city has launched an eighteen month project to update the Comprehensive Plan, which serves as a long-term guide for future growth and zoning. A task force is overseeing the work, and residents are encouraged to participate via the Envision Verona project website.

There is plenty to do today, including yoga at Insight Wellness, the Downtown Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park, pizza and a pitcher at Lake Lou-ee, and trivia at The Bogey Factory. Tomorrow, catch trivia at Hop Haus Brewing Company.
On August 17, the Verona Police Department successfully located and arrested a 21-year-old man in the 500 block of Cross Country Road regarding a probation violation.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Chocolate Caramel Twist. The store is currently closed for the morning but will open today at 10:00 AM.
